chapterInfo.content:
12
Nsase a Mose faeɛ no so ahemfo baanu ho asɛm
1Na yeinom ne asase no so ahemfo a Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn na wɔdii wɔn asase soɔ wɔ Yordan agya deɛ owiapueeɛ hɔ, firi Arnon subonhwa ho de kɔsi Hermon bepɔ ho ne Araba a ɛwɔ apueeɛ no nyinaa so, 2#Num 21.24 Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon a ɔdii hene firi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa nsunoa ne subonhwa no mfimfini ne Gilead fa de kɔsi Yabok subonhwa a ɛne Amonfoɔ hyeɛ no ano, 3ne Araba so de kɔsi Kinerot po no ano apueeɛ fam, na ɛde kɔsi Araba po no a ɛne Nkyene Po no ano, apueeɛ Bet-yesimot kwan so, ne anafoɔ fam Pisga bepɔ ase no; 4#Num 21.33; Deut 3.11 ne Basan hene Og a ɔfiri abrane akɛseɛ a aka no mu a ɔtenaa Astarot ne Edrei no asase no. 5Na ɔdii hene Hermon bepɔ so ne Salka ne Basan nyinaa de kɔsi Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ hyeɛ so ne Gilead fa, Hesbon hene Sihon hyeɛ ho. 6#Num 32.33 AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn, na AWURADE akoa Mose de asase no maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no maa wɔdii so.
Ahemfo a Yosua kumm wɔn
7Na yeinom ne asase no so ahemfo a Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam, firi Baal-gad a ɛda Lebanon bonhwa no mu de kɔsi bepɔ a ɛso petee a ɛforo de kɔ Seir no ho; (na Yosua de asase no maa Israel mmusuakuo sɛ wɔnni so sɛdeɛ wɔn nkyekyɛmu no teɛ, 8#Yos 11.3 mmepɔ no so ne ɛpo ho Araba so ne mmepɔ no ase ne ɛserɛ no so ne anafoɔ no: Hetifoɔ, Amorifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ asase no): 9#Yos 6.2; 8.29 Yerikohene, Ai a ɛwɔ Betel ho hene, 10#Yos 10.1, 3 Yerusalemhene, Hebronhene, 11#Yos 10.3 Yarmuthene, Lakishene, 12#Yos 10.3, 26, 33 Eglonhene, Geserhene, 13#Yos 10.39; Ate 1.11 Debirhene, Gederhene, 14#Ate 1.17; Num 21.1 Hormahene, Aradhene, 15#Yos 10.29-30 Libnahene, Adulamhene, 16#Yos 10.28 Makedahene, Betelhene, 17Tapuahene, Heferhene, 18#Yos 15.53; 1 Sa 4.1 Afekhene, Lasaronhene, 19#Yos 11.1, 10 Madonhene, Hasorhene, 20#Yos 11.1 Simron-meronhene, Aksafhene, 21Taanakhene, Megidohene, 22Kedeshene, Yokneam a ɛwɔ Karmel ase no hene, 23#Yos 11.2 Dor a ɛwɔ Dor kokoɔ soɔ hene, amanaman a ɛwɔ Gilgal no hene, 24Tirsahene, — ahemfo no nyinaa yɛ aduasa baako.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na yeinom ne asase no so ahemfo a Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn na wɔdii wɔn asase soɔ wɔ Yordan agya deɛ owiapueeɛ hɔ, firi Arnon subonhwa ho de kɔsi Hermon bepɔ ho ne Araba a ɛwɔ apueeɛ no nyinaa so, Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon a ɔdii hene firi Aroer a ɛda Arnon subonhwa nsunoa ne subonhwa no mfimfini ne Gilead fa de kɔsi Yabok subonhwa a ɛne Amonfoɔ hyeɛ no ano, ne Araba so de kɔsi Kinerot po no ano apueeɛ fam, na ɛde kɔsi Araba po no a ɛne Nkyene Po no ano, apueeɛ Bet-yesimot kwan so, ne anafoɔ fam Pisga bepɔ ase no; ne Basan hene Og a ɔfiri abrane akɛseɛ a aka no mu a ɔtenaa Astarot ne Edrei no asase no. Na ɔdii hene Hermon bepɔ so ne Salka ne Basan nyinaa de kɔsi Gesurfoɔ ne Maakatfoɔ hyeɛ so ne Gilead fa, Hesbon hene Sihon hyeɛ ho. AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn, na AWURADE akoa Mose de asase no maa Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no maa wɔdii so.

Na yeinom ne asase no so ahemfo a Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn Yordan agya atɔeɛ fam, firi Baal-gad a ɛda Lebanon bonhwa no mu de kɔsi bepɔ a ɛso petee a ɛforo de kɔ Seir no ho; (na Yosua de asase no maa Israel mmusuakuo sɛ wɔnni so sɛdeɛ wɔn nkyekyɛmu no teɛ, mmepɔ no so ne ɛpo ho Araba so ne mmepɔ no ase ne ɛserɛ no so ne anafoɔ no: Hetifoɔ, Amorifoɔ ne Kanaanfoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ asase no): Yerikohene, Ai a ɛwɔ Betel ho hene, Yerusalemhene, Hebronhene, Yarmuthene, Lakishene, Eglonhene, Geserhene, Debirhene, Gederhene, Hormahene, Aradhene, Libnahene, Adulamhene, Makedahene, Betelhene, Tapuahene, Heferhene, Afekhene, Lasaronhene, Madonhene, Hasorhene, Simron-meronhene, Aksafhene, Taanakhene, Megidohene, Kedeshene, Yokneam a ɛwɔ Karmel ase no hene, Dor a ɛwɔ Dor kokoɔ soɔ hene, amanaman a ɛwɔ Gilgal no hene, Tirsahene, — ahemfo no nyinaa yɛ aduasa baako.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
